posts.text: Kirsten slips up and sends fresh evidence of merspaniels
Yes, claims of Orban’s authoritarianism were sometimes exaggerated. But he was moving in that direction. And claims he was corrupt were not exaggerated at all. thedispatch.com/article/hung…
Thanks very much to my hosts at @CUChicago and all the folks who came out last night. Such good people.
“Good morning. It’s Wednesday. Thumb guy is still missing. So Zoe and I are following the special lady everywhere she goes. It’s important to stay vigilant. Also, I love you.”

I don’t know which is more preposterous, the legal assumptions behind this nonsense or the political ones.
